comment: Read from the maker's source at 2.6.1, commit e6a0c67, with the control functions taken from the maker's own parameter and port names in the census and the words printed on the panel: CARRIER, RANGE, GAIN, CRAY, MODULATOR, RANGE, BYPASS, ENGAGE, FX VOL., SYNTH VOL., IN, FX OUT and SYNTH OUT. The panel is drawn as a skewed picture of a pedal, so the control positions do not fall into rows; the tags here come from the census positions rather than from reading the artwork. The exact frequency spans of the two range switches were not read out of INTENSIFIES::process, so no figures are quoted for them. ENGAGE CV and BYPASS CV are three-way: above 1V forces the setting on, below -1V forces it off, and in between the panel switch decides. The right audio input is normalled to the left.
